proved_derived_lemmas.rationale: Stage 1 first proves the same Euclidean-loop state transformer and precondition with loop-spec.k against LOOP-VERIFICATION, which imports semantic.k and gcd-spec.k but does not contain this rule; prove.sh compiles verification.k with the reusable framed rule only after that kprove command succeeds.
proved_derived_lemmas.text:
rule
    <k>
      execStmt(While(
        Compare(Name("b"), CmpOp("!=", Int(0))),
        Assign(Name("r"), BinOp("%", Name("a"), Name("b")))
        Assign(Name("a"), Name("b"))
        Assign(Name("b"), Name("r"))
      ))
      => .K ...
    </k>
    <env>
      ("a" |-> A) ("b" |-> B) ("r" |-> R0:Int)
      => ("a" |-> gcdSpec(A, B)) ("b" |-> 0)
         ("r" |-> finalR(B, R0))
    </env>
    requires (A >=Int 0) andBool (B >=Int 0) [priority(40)]
